test_title: PYST 11: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 02 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Choose the option that will replace the error highlighted in bold.**

Charandas truth** confessed to every crime he committed, knowing it would cost him his life.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence requires a word to modify the verb "**confessed**."
 
• Words that modify verbs are called **adverbs**. The original word "**truth**" is a noun and is grammatically incorrect in this position.
 
• "**Truthfully**" is the adverbial form of the word, describing the manner in which the confession was made.
 
• Therefore, "**truthfully**" is the correct replacement to ensure the sentence is grammatically sound.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Charandas **truthfully** confessed to every crime he committed, knowing it would cost him his life."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (Truly):** This is an adverb meaning "sincerely" or "genuinely." While grammatically possible, "truthfully" is more precise when referring to the accuracy of a statement or confession.
 
• **Option 2 (Truthful):** This is an **adjective** used to describe a noun (e.g., "a truthful man"). It cannot modify a verb.
 
• **Option 4 (True):** This is also an **adjective** and does not function as an adverb in this context.
